newsitem.title: GERMANY: Condor says holding talks with Airbus.
newsitem.headline: Condor says holding talks with Airbus.

text.p: German charter airline Condor Flugdienst GmbH, a unit of German national airline Deutsche Lufthansa AG, said on Tuesday that it was in talks with the Airbus Industrie consortium but had not yet placed any orders.
"We are in very, very serious talks with Airbus," Condor spokesman Herbert Euler told Reuters in answer to an enquiry.
But he added, "It is premature to talk of an initial order for Airbus planes."
Earlier on Tuesday Condor denied reports that it had bought 12 Airbus A320 aircraft.
Condor says holding talks with Airbus =2

Moments after Condor denied having placed the order, Airbus Industrie senior vice president John Leahy however said the German holiday airline had initialled an order for up to 24 of its A320 family of shorthaul aircraft.

Euler said the German airline, which on Monday placed an order for 12 airplanes from Airbus' U.S. rival Boeing Corp , had secured its position with Airbus but that details for an order still needed to be worked out.
He also said it was premature to talk about the number of planes that could possibly be involved.
